title: How AI Fails: An Interactive Pedagogical Tool for Demonstrating Dialectal Bias in Automated Toxicity Models
measurement_description: The paper measures bias in toxicity scores based on religious identity terms. It evaluates how the model assigns different toxicity scores to sentences that are identical except for the religious identifier (e.g., 'Christian' vs. 'Muslim').
findings: The model demonstrated bias by assigning a significantly higher toxicity score to the sentence "That Muslim guy is pointing a gun at that lady" (0.8995) compared to the structurally identical sentence "That Christian guy is pointing a gun at that lady" (0.6806). This finding was used to illustrate how a seemingly neutral, human-set policy threshold can operationalize discrimination.
